shots.name: 01-case
shots.caption: One fictional case. Information scattered across reports, calls, payments and vehicle records.

shots.name: 02-sources
shots.caption: Four prepared synthetic sources have been processed. Invalid records are flagged for review.

shots.name: 03-records
shots.caption: Source rows remain available. Extraction preserves where each piece of information came from.

shots.name: 04-resolution
shots.caption: Similar names are a proposal, not an automatic merge. Shared phone and vehicle records support review.

shots.name: 05-entity
shots.caption: Rahul’s record now retains the reviewed alias and the original source mentions.

shots.name: 06-path
shots.caption: A computed six-hop path connects Rahul to Vikram through phones, Amit Verma and bank accounts.

shots.name: 07-discovery
shots.caption: Rahul → P101 → P204 → Amit → A17 → A31 → Vikram. Every step has supporting evidence.

shots.name: 08-communication
shots.caption: Lead 17 is computed: 11 calls versus a historical median of 2, alongside seven new contacts.

shots.name: 09-transfers
shots.caption: Three connected transfers total ₹1,95,000 over 75 minutes. These are review signals, not accusations.

shots.name: 10-evidence
shots.caption: The explanation reaches the exact source: transaction file, row 2, timestamp and unaltered excerpt.

shots.name: 11-review
shots.caption: The investigator records Needs more evidence. Human judgment remains separate from analytical priority.

shots.name: 12-audit
shots.caption: The decision is recorded with reviewer, reason and previous/new state in the audit history.

shots.name: 13-finale
shots.caption: VEIL reduces the search space with explainable leads. The system does not determine guilt.
